Markets don’t move on facts alone.

Warsh is seen as strictly anti-QE, which raises the probability of a more aggressive focus on Fed balance sheet reduction.
That means bond selling / tighter liquidity, which can cool off risk assets.
At the same time, short-term rate cuts are being discussed as a possibility, aligning with what Trump would prefer.

✅ Immediate Impact Expectations

📌 Dollar strength becomes the first reaction trade.
📌 If the Dollar holds higher:
Risk assets may cool off
Gold & Silver may face sharp correction pressure
Volatility increases because markets start questioning Fed independence under Trump
Emerging Market Impact (India Included)
Stronger Dollar generally triggers capital shifting back to the US
Emerging markets may face reduced inflows or outflows.

INR depreciation risk increases
✅ Positive for exports
❌ Negative for imports

✅ RBI Angle
With a strong Dollar + weaker INR, RBI may have less flexibility to cut rates aggressively, as currency pressure and imported inflation become key risks.
